$ruleRationale.react-doctor/query-mutation-missing-inva: Audited all 22 sites during #491. 21 are false positives (extracted invalidate() helpers, setQueryData, not-applicable paths like logout/download/navigation, and useCrudMutations wrapper). The one real gap at BlogCategoryCard.tsx:82 was fixed in the same PR.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-giant-component: Tracked in #492 — each flagged component needs a focused split PR. Dependency-update is not the place.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/prefer-dynamic-import: Tracked in #492 — route-level React.lazy() adoption (estimated 30-40% initial-bundle savings).
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-event-handler: Tracked in #492 — waiting on React's stable useEffectEvent. (Rule renamed from no-effect-event-handler in react-doctor 0.4.0.)
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-cascading-set-state: Tracked in #492 — single site at AiSettingsPage.tsx where cascading is intentional in a form-sync effect.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-inline-exhaustive-style: Tracked in #492 — inline styles in surfaces (e.g. main.tsx error fallback) that render outside MUI's ThemeProvider so sx/theme aren't available there.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-array-index-as-key: Tracked in #492 — sites in forms/ where FormFieldInput lacks a server-side id pre-save. Real fix requires a stable client-id (crypto.randomUUID) on field creation; follow-up issue queued.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-many-boolean-props: Tracked in #492 — WorkflowActions has boolean-shaped props that genuinely represent independent permission states; refactor to compound components is a deliberate architectural decision, not a dependency-update tweak.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-render-prop-children: Tracked in #492 — DataTableV2 (4-slot render props) is a deliberate composability seam; compound-component refactor would be a breaking change for every list page that consumes it.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-react19-deprecated-apis: Sites still use useContext (works on React 19; not actually deprecated). Migration to `use()` will land alongside other React 19 ergonomics work — tracked in #492.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/rendering-hydration-mismatc: Forja admin is a pure CSR SPA — no SSR, no hydration. The `new Date()` warnings are by-design false positives in this architecture.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/rerender-state-only-in-hand: Overwhelmingly false positives. The rule flags useState that isn't read in JSX, but our patterns (isDirty flags, trigger state, focus state passed only via callback props) intentionally use useState for re-render coupling without rendering the value. Triage queued in #492 for case-by-case useRef migration where applicable.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/advanced-event-handler-refs: Tracked in #492 — useEffect handlers re-subscribe on identity change; ref-based fix lands alongside the prefer-useReducer wave.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/async-await-in-loop: Sequential by design (LegalDocumentDetail batch dependencies, MediaDetailDialog ordered uploads). Promise.all would change ordering semantics.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/js-combine-iterations: Stylistic micro-perf (`.filter().forEach()`); the two-pass form is more readable at our list sizes (<1000 items typical). Not worth churn.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/js-hoist-intl: Eligible for module-scope hoisting; tracked in #492 as a follow-up bundled with other locale-format cleanups.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/js-index-maps: array.find() in loops — at our cardinalities (<100 items) the O(n*m) cost is single-digit microseconds. Map index construction would add code for negligible win.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/js-set-map-lookups: array lookup in loop — same cardinality argument as js-index-maps.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/js-tosorted-immutable: [...arr].sort(). `Array.prototype.toSorted` is ES2023; Vite's default target may not include it for all supported browsers. Migrate alongside the next tsconfig.json target bump.
$ruleRationale.deslop/unused-export: Unused exports (RADII tokens, validation helpers) are public surface for the libs/client SDK consumers — pruning requires SDK coordination. (Rule renamed from knip/exports in react-doctor 0.4.0.)
$ruleRationale.deslop/unused-file: Candidate dead files — verification (lazy imports, route configs, external SDK consumers) needs care; tracked as a separate cleanup sweep, not bundled with dependency work. (Rule renamed from knip/files in react-doctor 0.4.0.)
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-adjust-state-on-prop-cha: All sites are the intentional controlled-reset pattern in the dialog/wizard layer — `useEffect(() => { if (!open) setX('') }, [open])` (ConfirmDialog, DangerConfirmDialog, TransferOwnershipDialog, CreateFormWizard, FormTemplateDialog, MediaDetailDialog, SubmissionDetailDrawer, PageSectionsTab). The canonical fix (parent-driven `key` remount) is a cross-cutting architectural change touching every call site. Tracked in #492; not a dependency-update change. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-reset-all-state-on-prop-: Same dialog/wizard controlled-reset pattern as no-adjust-state-on-prop-change — state cleared when the `open` prop toggles. Tracked in #492. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-chain-state-updates: Effect-coordination sites (SiteFormDialog, SiteContext) where a second state derives from a settled first update; same family as the already-suppressed no-cascading-set-state. Tracked in #492. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-pass-data-to-parent: ContentDetailPage syncs locale-form snapshots up to its parent via effect — a deliberate seam in the shared content-detail abstraction; lifting it is an architectural change. Tracked in #492. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/jsx-max-depth: Maintainability heuristic (depth > threshold), overwhelmingly in route trees (App.tsx) and rich dialogs. Same class as no-giant-component — each split is a focused refactor PR, not dependency-update work. Tracked in #492. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/jsx-no-jsx-as-prop: Perf heuristic flagging JSX passed as props — the overwhelming majority are MUI slot/`startIcon`/`endIcon`/`renderInput` props and design-system icon props, which are idiomatic and cheap. Case-by-case memoization tracked in #492. New in react-doctor 0.4.0.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/prefer-useReducer: Flags components with many related useState calls (suggesting useReducer). Migrate only where state genuinely forms a state machine, case-by-case — same long-standing decision carried from the pre-0.4.0 config. Tracked in #492.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/exhaustive-deps: All flagged sites are intentional effects that already carry justified `eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comments (DOM re-check on tour activation, unmount-only cleanup, query-id-triggered model discovery, one-shot preferences hydration). Adding the 'missing' deps would change behavior. react-doctor's rule is distinct from the eslint one; suppressed at rule level with the same documented intent.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/no-derived-state: Flagged sites are the intentional editable-form-seeded-from-prop pattern (FormTemplateDialog seeds local form state from the `template` prop on open; the user then edits those fields) and the prev-ref reset in QuickTour. Local state is genuinely required; the canonical key-remount fix is the same #492 architectural change as no-adjust-state-on-prop-change.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/prefer-tag-over-role: Flagged roles are correct ARIA with no clean native equivalent, or intentional: role=status/aria-live live regions (LoadingState/EmptyState/HealthStrip), role=img on CSS-background avatars (Avatar), role=region landmark (GlobalSaveBar), and DataTableV2's deliberate ARIA grid built on CSS-grid divs (a semantic <table> would break the responsive layout). Semantic-tag migration where it genuinely applies is tracked in #492.
$ruleRationale.react-doctor/only-export-components: Co-located helpers exported beside components (seoFieldSpecs, presetToDays, etc.). This only affects React Fast Refresh granularity in dev; extracting each to a sibling module is import churn tracked in #492, not dependency-update work.
$ruleRationale.deslop/unused-dependency: knip-style unused-dependency detection has frequent false positives (deps used via build config, type-only, or runtime/CLI). Verification needs care; tracked with the other deslop sweeps (unused-export/unused-file) in #492. (Renamed from knip in react-doctor 0.4.0.)
$ruleRationale.deslop/unused-dev-dependency: Same caveat as deslop/unused-dependency — dev deps are frequently used only by config/CLI that static analysis misses. Tracked in #492. (Renamed from knip in react-doctor 0.4.0.)
$ruleRationale.src/components/shared/HighlightedCodeEdi: Custom syntax-highlighted textarea. See in-file comment for the pattern explanation — outline:none and the inline styles are intentional architecture.
